text:
Nina H: Quick sync 10min1: fintech client (Monolith Bank) wants a drop-in replacement for their current LLM vendor. Key asks: exact JSON keys in responses, sub-120ms latency for sync calls, KMS/HSM support, and a side-by-side pricing comparison. POC Wed.
Omar J: They assert `payload.results[].confidence_pct` and `payload.trace_id` must exist. We can mirror keys; confidence_pct is 0-100 vs our 0-1 floats.
Talia G: I'll build a tiny compatibility shim that renames fields and scales confidence. Will add a prompt prefix marker to match their tuned prompts; note token delta.
sec-bot: Redwood supports AWS/GCP/Azure KMS and Partner HSM for VPC. SOC2/ISO artifacts available. For staging with client data require signed DPA and org-scoped KMS.
legal-bot: LOA required for on-prem key imports; SLA addendum possible for Dedicated deployments.
Nina H: Action items: 1) Talia: shim + README + docker by EOD Tue. 2) Omar: pricing delta doc (short/med/long examples) by Tue noon. 3) Sec/Legal: LOA/DPA note and timeline.
Omar J: I'll include three prompts (20t, 200t, 1200t) with competitor segments vs our tokens and an estimated $/1000 calls.
Talia G: Shim will append `--compat:monolith_v1` to prompt and preserve `trace_id`. Expect ~40-70ms added. Will instrument metrics.
Nina H: Good. Keep this thread for POC artifacts delivery and I'll send kickoff once we have the shim and pricing.
